name: Wix
thesis: Two-engine model — (1) Base44 ARR scales rapidly post-acquisition as the AI-first builder, while (2) the core Creative Subs business holds single-digit-but-positive growth. FCF margin compression in 2026 is acceptable (high-teens FCF margin is fine) as long as Base44 ARR keeps stair-stepping at milestone disclosures and core Partners + fintech stay in low-to-mid-teens growth. The payoff is a WHOLE-COMPANY re-rate toward ~3x revenue as FCF normalizes - Base44 is embedded optionality (it looks cheap IF private vibecoding valuations are even somewhat rational), realized via the consolidated re-rate, NOT a separate spin. Overhang to respect: the $1.6B buyback executed at ~$92 (stock ~$62) levered the balance sheet and is a real near-term drag.
key_driver: Base44 ARR growth (milestone-disclosed) + Creative Subs holding positive

tier_1_kpis.name: Base44 ARR (milestone disclosure)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: >9 months without a milestone update (silence = stalling), OR any disclosed ARR number that implies <100% YoY growth from prior milestone

tier_1_kpis.name: Creative Subscriptions Revenue Growth (CC)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Turns negative, OR <5% for 2 consecutive Qs (single-digit positive is acceptable)

tier_2_kpis.name: Partners revenue growth (Q1'26)
tier_2_kpis.current: +19% YoY ($203M) - decelerating from +24% three Qs ago (self-inflicted Studio marketing pullback)

tier_2_kpis.name: Wix Payments GPV + transaction revenue (Q1'26)
tier_2_kpis.current: Transaction revenue $70M (+19% YoY); GPV $3.8B (+12% YoY); take rate 1.84% (+3bps)

nuance.bear_case: AI builders commoditize SMB site creation. 'Massively undervalued vs private comps' doesn't survive sizing: Base44 (~$100M ARR) is only ~5% of revenue and is CONSOLIDATED, so Lovable's ~16x / Replit's ~37x ARR multiples don't transfer without a spin (no signal of one). Even at a generous 10x ARR, Base44 is ~$1B of ~$2.2B EV - implying the core trades ~0.6x sales (that IS the cheap part). Add the FCF-margin guide cut (low-mid-20s to high-teens), S&M nearly doubling, and a $1.6B buyback at ~$92 (stock ~$62) that levered the balance sheet, and the 'interim' margin hit looks longer and more structural than the bull case assumes.
nuance.adversarial_take: Wix owns Base44, so the AI-first builder is additive to their funnel rather than cannibalistic — but if Base44 ARR ever stalls between milestones, the bull case collapses because core Creative Subs alone doesn't justify the multiple at single-digit growth.
nuance.stress_test: Two consecutive Qs of Creative Subs <5% growth + a Base44 milestone gap >9 months would force a thesis re-evaluation.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Base44 ARR growth decelerates below 100% YoY (vs. milestone trajectory)
FCF margin compression extends into 2027 without Base44 monetization story progressing

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

bear_deltas.note: Thesis-break bear (2026-07 red team): Creative Subs growth turns negative, FCF-margin compression extends into 2027, Base44 monetization fizzles and the multiple derates - growth -6pp, margin -4pp, exit -6 turns, terminal g -0.5pp. Implied bear FV ~$30/sh vs ~$50 live (-40%). Pending owner review.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY < 10% for 2Q — durable creator-tooling growth thesis breaks; consumer SaaS floor.
FCF margin < 15% for 2Q — high-teens FCF is acceptable per the thesis, so the hard floor is 15 (relaxed from 18); below that the FCF-compounder thesis is genuinely in question.
Studio ARR YoY < 30% — Studio is the agency-tier growth lever; sub-30 means the upmarket expansion stalls.
Partners (agency / pro creator) revenue share < 30% for 2Q — the high-AOV monetization mix-shift thesis reverses.
